visibilityPolicy.authorityHeading: CURRENT OVERRIDE — 2026-10-03 — DIFFICULTY 재검 / PRIOR LEVEL VISIBILITY ALLOWED
visibilityPolicy.legacyFieldInterpretation: blindPassStatus/FRESH_INDEPENDENT and blindReviewerId are retained schema labels for a current-pass difficulty judgment. They do not assert a different reviewer, a separate session, or prior non-exposure.
visibilityPolicy.independentAxisMeaning: The actual item-specific difficulty rationale evaluates the minimum valid solution, condition interpretation, strategy choice and combination burden separately from the RPM/PT/TPL classification; it is not inferred from legacy level or taxonomy keys.
visibilityPolicy.targetedRecheckMeaning: Existing independent samples/rechecks and resolved adjudications support boundary, low-confidence and abnormal legacy compatibility cases. Their existence is not asserted for every item.
visibilityPolicy.currentAssemblerVisibility: This receipt assembler reads final metadata and prior author/review evidence. It is not a new source-first or blind mathematical reviewer.

relationalLegacyCompatibility.observation: The six recorded relational provenance failures expose a mismatch between the current-pass visibility policy and the official validator legacy requirement candidateVisibleDuringDecision=false. Their actual visibility and official failures remain unchanged; no passing receipt is synthesized.

validationScope: Official resolver input/evidence exact recomputation and official receipts, plus actual final-candidate difficulty/relational/finalization checks. Not a new mathematical solution or visual certification. Resolver-decision receipts and full-finalization receipts have separate validation scopes.

compactionContract.retainedHashedEvidence: difficultyEvidence, semanticMetaEvidence and difficultyDecisionBinding are byte-value equivalent to the full frozen report; their historical absolute paths are intentionally retained because they are part of the evidence hashes.
compactionContract.reconstructedBody: Read the exact packaged input/result and shared authorityRefs by ordinal+curriculum. Resolve the input with the official resolver to recover semanticInputBundle; attach package authorityRefs in their indexed order; validate the reconstructed supplied evidence. Its evidenceSha and the full validateResolverEvidence result SHA must equal the frozen values.
compactionContract.historicalPathRebase: For checking historical proof-file references on another checkout, the replay helper maps the suffix after /m3-meta/ to --repo-root. Hashes and stored evidence are not rewritten.
